protocol.server: One ephemeral localhost server; identical URL and gzip text/max-age=600/MIME/404 rules for both arms
protocol.order: For each pair: mobile BEFORE → AFTER, desktop BEFORE → AFTER; no concurrent browser
protocol.profiles: Fresh Chrome per observation; Lighthouse default mobile / official desktop config; simulated throttling; default storage reset; first visit/loader enabled
protocol.retention: At most 3 owned runs / 14 days; 128 MiB per run; 64 KiB per worker log; profiles removed
protocol.claim: Lab measurements; no field INP/CWV or automatic visual/release acceptance
